_comment: Curated from public repositories of qormsxo. Descriptions are summaries of each repository README. Do not invent stacks.

lines: Ticketing backend that absorbs booking spikes
with Kafka and stops double-selling a seat
via Redis Redlock + SELECT FOR UPDATE.
Real-time recommendation API: clicks and likes
become taste vectors in BullMQ workers.
A semantic cache skips repeat LLM calls.
PoC gateway that puts several AI providers
behind one interface, queues work in BullMQ,
then masks and formats the result.
Daily news digest: collects themed articles,
summarizes them in 3 lines with Gemini,
and sends them to KakaoTalk via GitHub Actions.
Approval workflow PoC with role-based transitions
draft > submitted > in_review > approved/rejected
and per-state statistics.
Learning-log pipeline: quiz submits return 202,
Redis tracks EXP / streak / combo live,
and a 5-minute cron builds ML-ready features.
AI BGM search and AI character chat backend.
Redis look-aside cache, batched play counters,
and SSE streaming of AI responses.
Print-on-demand commerce backend with async
settlement jobs, plus a guardrail layer that
checks AI / non-developer requests before use.
